panels.description:
Merged MRs per author classified as Light (<50 lines), Standard (<500) or Heavy by size, merge commits excluded. MRs whose commits were not collected (most MRs before 2024, about 1 in 5 since), environment promotion MRs and MRs imported from GitHub are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_commits, commits, commit_parents, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- Per author, classifies merged MRs as Light/Standard/Heavy by total lines changed (merge commits excluded) and reports counts and percentages for authors with at least 3 MRs.
-- MRs whose commits were not collected are left out, and so are environment promotion MRs (from a branch that at least 20 MRs target).
WITH long_lived_branches AS (
  -- branches that at least 20 MRs target (dev, stage, master, ...); an MR from one of them promotes a whole environment
  SELECT lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  FROM pull_requests lb
  WHERE lb.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  GROUP BY lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
mr_size AS (
  SELECT pr.id,
         pr.author_id,
         SUM(c.additions + c.deletions) AS lines_changed
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  JOIN commits c                ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED'
    AND pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND COALESCE(pr.description, '') NOT LIKE '*Created by%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM long_lived_branches llb WHERE llb.base_repo_id = pr.base_repo_id AND llb.base_ref = pr.head_ref)
  GROUP BY pr.id, pr.author_id
),
weighted AS (
  SELECT author_id,
         CASE WHEN lines_changed <  50 THEN 'Light'
              WHEN lines_changed < 500 THEN 'Standard'
              ELSE                          'Heavy'
         END AS weight
  FROM mr_size
)
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), '(unmapped)')                                                            AS `Developer`,
       COUNT(*)                                                                  AS `Total MRs`,
       SUM(w.weight = 'Light')                                                   AS Light,
       CONCAT(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(w.weight = 'Light')    / COUNT(*), 1), '%')      AS 'Light%',
       SUM(w.weight = 'Standard')                                                AS Standard,
       CONCAT(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(w.weight = 'Standard') / COUNT(*), 1), '%')      AS 'Standard%',
       SUM(w.weight = 'Heavy')                                                   AS Heavy,
       CONCAT(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(w.weight = 'Heavy')    / COUNT(*), 1), '%')      AS 'Heavy%'
FROM weighted w
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = w.author_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
GROUP BY a.id
HAVING `Total MRs` >= 3
ORDER BY `Total MRs` DESC;

select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name

list.definition:
SELECT CONCAT(r.name, '--', r.id) AS text 
FROM project_mapping pm 
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pm.row_id 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
ORDER BY text

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  -- gitlab board ids match repo ids
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- MR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id, NULL AS fallback_name, 0 AS assignee
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  -- MR reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id, NULL, 0
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, from issue_assignees and issues.assignee_id (the :0 placeholder means unassigned)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name, 1
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, 1
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND i.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
)
-- assignees with no account row keep their GitLab username; bots are left out
SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(MAX(sa.fallback_name), _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), sa.account_id), '--', sa.account_id) AS Name
FROM scoped_accounts sa
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = sa.account_id
GROUP BY sa.account_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
HAVING NOT COALESCE(a.user_name, '') LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
ORDER BY Name
